## What's new

**Fix: making a Personal Guard invite code failed**
- Clicking **Get invite code** showed *Invite code could not be made: An object could not be cloned.* (Vencord). The plugin now sends plain data to the server, so codes are made again. The same fix applies to encrypted sync.

## Update

Use the update notification in Discord, or the installer at https://friendsinvoice.sarhsoft.com. If it fails, download `FriendsInVoice-v1.22.2.zip`, extract the whole archive and run `repair.bat` (macOS: `repair.command`, Linux: `bash repair.sh`).

BetterDiscord: replace the installed plugin with `FriendsInVoice.plugin.js` from this release and enable it.
